dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Sadly, the Jade Chamber, which once blotted out the sun and moon, has now been swallowed up by the waves of the Sea of Clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: They say that seasons come and seasons go, and that all things must rise and fall. Thus it is with the ancient gods, and so it is with mortal works. There is nothing there to mourn.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: So they say. But still, I cannot help but sigh when I consider the fate of the Jade Chamber...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: To sacrifice the work she had carved with her own hands over so many years...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: And to do so without hesitation or regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang's stratagems are beyond my ability to grasp...
